author: BenCos18
install_msg: Configure a staff channel with `[p]contactsetup #channel`, then post a user panel with `[p]contactpanel #channel`. Users can close their own tickets with `[p]contactclose <ticket-id>`. The dashboard supports full transcripts, replies, and staff closure. `[p]support open @user` can create additional tickets for the same user.
name: Contact
description: Forwards user DMs to a configured staff channel and provides staff reply, close, and transcript commands.
